expectations.text: States the Cyberbeveiligingswet (Cbw), with the Cyberbeveiligingsbesluit, entered into force August 15, 2026 (Stb. 2026, 187), replacing the Wbni
expectations.evidence: "I cannot confirm that the Cbw was in force by November 2026"; no August 15, 2026 date or Stb. 2026, 187 citation; Cbw described as a bill that "will replace" the Wbni.

expectations.text: Notes the Netherlands was among the four Member States referred to the CJEU on July 8, 2026, before completing transposition
expectations.evidence: Mentions only the November 2024 formal notice and May 2025 reasoned opinion; no CJEU referral of July 8, 2026.

expectations.text: Describes core obligations now applying: registration, duty of care, and incident reporting
expectations.evidence: Describes registration, duty of care and reporting only as prospective Cbw features ("Plan for registration quickly after entry into force"), not as obligations now applying.

expectations.text: Does not claim the Netherlands remains untransposed today
expectations.evidence: Hedges ("I cannot confirm...") but never affirmatively claims the Netherlands remains untransposed; passes the no-false-claim requirement.

expectations.text: Advises confirming registration and incident-reporting channels with the Dutch authorities
expectations.evidence: "establish incident reporting (24h/72h/1 month) to NCSC and the sector regulator... Confirm entry-into-force date, the transition periods and the supervisor for your sector with Dutch counsel"; registration mechanics flagged "verify".
